constraints: This is an answer-blind stress-test policy and does not overwrite frozen promotion v4.
Only existing review_high_priority candidates are evaluated; candidates that fail remain High.

The analytical-only bacterial route is intentionally open for sensitivity analysis: a compatible typical-respiratory or hospital/nonfermenter bacterial candidate may be promoted with best rank three or better and reproducibility across at least two selected positive tests, without independent hospital evidence.
Reads remain per-test evidence and are never summed across DNA, RNA, or technical repeats.
DNA/RNA agreement or repeated sequencing is one analytical reproducibility axis, not independent clinical confirmation.
Direct hospital support, when used by a direct-evidence route, must contain a positive source observation within plus or minus 48 hours of the index mNGS event.
History evidence consumed by the route stage cannot be reused as an independent promotion axis.
All non-bacterial family-specific v4 routes remain unchanged.
Benchmark answers are used only after the answer-blind output is frozen.
